literal_meaning: উঠানকে সমুদ্র মনে করা (courtyard mistaken for ocean)
figurative_meaning_en: Superstitious; narrow-minded or homebound person; coward
similar_in_english: Small fish in a big pond (reverse)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে উঠান-সমুদ্র মানুষ, কখনো শহরে যায়নি।
এই উঠান-সমুদ্র মনোভাবে কী করে বিশ্বাস করবে?
example_sentences_in_english: He is a courtyard-ocean person, never been to the city.
With this courtyard-ocean mindset, how can he believe it?
note: Refers to a person with a very limited perspective, akin to mistaking one's immediate surroundings for the entire world.
